note: Each Business Unit can now have its own letterhead. In Settings → Business Units, edit a BU to set a logo, company name, address, contact line, and per-output document/version control numbers. The PDFs for a BU project (Gantt, Project Summary) automatically use that BU letterhead, and the Gantt — grouped by BU — shows each unit logo and details per section. Any field left blank on a BU falls back to the Main Company default under Settings → Report Letterhead. Projects with no BU use that default.
